x: Ran second in Wirral A.C. 10 Miles' Championship Cup, when on leave. Will Nankeville has moved to Hamburg from Brussels, where he had a good time with the Union St.

Will Nankeville was up the front for most of the way in the 880 yards, but was four yards behind the winner in third place, in 1.59. David Main found his true form in the Mile and won from Nankiwell (Southgate) and Bingham (Finchley) by six yards in 4.37.2.

Will Nankeville also ran the "race of his life" by finishing 6th in the 1,500 metres final and when one looked through the list of those qualifying for the final, this was indeed a sterling performance.
